verdict.rationale: Warp documents a public API: its platform is described as "API, CLI, SDK and MCP", the Automation Platform runs cloud agents from "triggers, schedules, integrations, and APIs", and API keys support headless, non-interactive authentication. A probe found a published OpenAPI spec at docs.warp.dev/openapi.json. missing for 10: endpoint-level documentation of what the API can do, evidence the API covers more than cloud agents/automation (e.g., the desktop terminal), independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
